Products and offers — App Store Connect (asc-products on VPN-731, read 2026-11-12 18:27 UTC) and Adapty (export 2026-11-12 09:41Z). 1 of 3; prices and offers are in the next two notes.
Prices on the frames are samples: App Store sandbox prices in the app screenshots, Adapty's sample values in the Adapty previews. The App Store sets the real price per country. Adapty's USD value is not the store price.
All 8 products are auto-renewable subscriptions in the group "Premium Membership". iPhone, iPad and Mac use the same products (one app record). No non-subscription in-app purchase.
Placements: as Adapty names them. (B) = Paywall Builder placement. On iPhone a push shows its Adapty layout when its products load. If they do not load, and always on iPad, the app shows its own Premium screen with the HOME_TOP_LEFT_PREMIUM plans (Yearly, Monthly, Weekly).

• com.yearlyMembership — Yearly — 1 year — group level 1. Intro: none. Promotional: pay up front for the first year ("%50OFF" by its name). Win-back: 3 months free. Adapty offers 599380d9 and 268f5fc3. Placements: HOME_TOP_LEFT_PREMIUM, PROFILE_PREMIUM, SERVER_PREMIUM, Home / Server / Settings Premium flows; WIN_BACK_YEARLY_OFFER (B), NOT_USING_USERS_PREMIUM (B).
• com.monthlyMembership — Monthly — 1 month — level 1. Intro: none. Promotional: 1 month free ("Premium 30 Trial"). Adapty offer 8eff407d. Placements: HOME_TOP_LEFT_PREMIUM, PROFILE_PREMIUM, the three Premium flows; PROMOTIONAL_CANCEL_FIRST_SUBSCRIPTION_MONTHLY (B).
